card.title: Director of Operations - Industrial Manufacturing
card.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

**Position Summary:**

 

Reporting to the site General Manager, the Director of Operations will manage the daily production, inventory, and logistics to ensure save, efficient, cost-effective, and timely delivery to our customers. They are responsible for development and implementation of strategy, growth, and profitability targets for the PSG-Grand Rapids facility. They will have direct ownership for established safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and lean objectives. Additional areas of reasonability include but are not limited to the oversight of: Safety, Plant Management, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Capital Equipment, Facilities Planning, Workforce Development, and Operations Strategy Deployment. A successful individual will deploy and maintain strong operational processes, be data driven, drive continuous improvement, and empower his or her team to solve problems.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

 

* Manage business to achieve/exceed agreed-upon growth, revenue, and operating income objectives
* Oversee end-to-end supply chain partnerships, warehousing, inventory management, and transportation
* Ensure products meet operations’ profitability goals
* Establish strategic direction, performance metrics, standards, and measurements for direct reports and the operation as a whole that support safety, quality, and delivery expectations
* Sets operational goals and objectives, and guides teams to meet monthly, quarterly and annual targets
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the P&L and continuously execute to achieve revenue and margin commitments
* Provide support and leadership to the supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, and continuous improvement teams by:
 + Supporting sales & operations planning (S&OP) process, and planning manufacturing capacity accordingly to ensure on time and efficient delivery
 + Identifying and responding to trends in the marketplace, anticipating and applying strategies to be ahead of the cost and quality curve
 + Planning and executing a best in class supply chain to ensure appropriate levels of inventory and turns as well as supplier quality and cost
 + Directing the continuous improvement program and supporting on site initiatives as required to ensure adoption of programs and achievement of desired results
 + Ensuring that products are delivered on-time to customers and that products meet all customer expectations regarding quality and performance
 + Planning and implementing capital improvements for the site and operations
* Work proactively with and effectively engaging functional counterparts to ensure overall organizational success and continuity of leadership
* Partner with union leadership to maintain compliance with the collective bargaining agreement while supporting operational goals
* Foster a positive employee relations environment through building a culture where employees are motivated and actively engaged in driving continuous improvement in the business
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and mentors, provides feedback, and takes action as needed to build a high-performing department
Embody the Company’s ethics and values; maintain the highest corporate governance principles 

**Qualifications** :

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, or a related field is required
* MBA/Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other operational leadership role
* Experience in a build to order/high-mix manufacturing environment required
* Proven background in the application of production/inventory control, procurement procedures and techniques, and logistics

This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

Attention Applicants: If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

Disclaimer: This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the team member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

card.title: Plant Manager - Durham, NC
card.description:
Job Summary:
 
Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and leads production activities for assigned manufacturing facilities and/or value streams with direct accountability for safety, quality, cost, schedule attainment, and on-time delivery. Provides site-level leadership to ensure daily execution aligns with production plans, customer requirements, standard work, and business objectives. Partners cross functionally with Planning, Materials, Engineering, Quality, HR, and Manufacturing leadership to remove constraints, improve process discipline, and drive continuous improvement throughout the operation.

**Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of supervisory or site leadership experience and 5–7 years of manufacturing experience preferred. In lieu of a degree, a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 8 years of supervisory or relevant manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a manufacturing site, department, or value stream with accountability for safety, quality, schedule, cost, labor planning, and daily execution.
* Experience leading production managers or production teams through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong understanding of production scheduling, capacity planning, labor utilization, material readiness, ERP/MRP discipline, and schedule attainment in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated competency with ERP systems used in manufacturing environments; IFS, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, visual management, standard work, root cause problem solving, and Corrective Action/Preventive Action practices; Six Sigma and/or Lean certification preferred or actively pursuing.
* Ability to use operational data, reports, and KPIs to communicate performance versus goals and drive improvement in safety, quality, cost, schedule, productivity, and on-time delivery.
* Knowledge of safe work practices, OSHA requirements, incident prevention, corrective action closure, and operational organization standards.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and documentation, including schematics, assembly drawings, operational manuals, safety rules, Methods of Manufacture, and standardized work instructions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional issue resolution with Engineering, Quality, Materials, Planning, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to minimize delays and improve execution.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and leadership skills with the ability to engage peers, leaders, and employees at all levels of the organization.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office and scheduling software.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and site/value stream performance across safety, site security, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, and on time delivery.
* Maintains a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring standards, procedures, legal regulations, OSHA requirements, local regulations and company safety practices are followed.
* Leads safety culture, 5S, operational organization, corrective actions, and incident prevention activities across assigned production areas.
* Maintains a positive and accountable culture where safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost control, and customer requirements are treated as core operating priorities.
* Leads value stream team through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and disciplined execution of the operating plan.
* Owns daily and weekly production attainment by aligning labor, material readiness, equipment availability, engineering support, and production priorities to meet schedule commitments.
* Drives constraint resolution and escalates issues that impact scope, schedule, quality, cost, or customer delivery commitments.
* Identifies, contains, and follows proper procedures for non-conforming material; supports accurate tracking, timely disposition, corrective action, and closure of NCRs.
* Ensures alignment cross-functionally with Engineering, Quality, Planning, Materials, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to resolve issues, reduce delays, improve process discipline, and support continual product improvement.
* Manages controllable operating costs, labor productivity, overtime, indirect labor utilization, rework, scrap, tools, equipment, and other cost drivers within assigned areas.
* Identifies cost savings opportunities and leads continuous improvement efforts that improve safety, quality, flow, productivity, throughput, and resource utilization.
* Leverages metrics and KPIs to identify performance gaps, establish priorities, communicate progress, and promote a culture of continuous improvement across assigned departments.
* Addresses employee performance, attendance, and standards-of-work issues in partnership with HR and Manufacturing leadership.
* Works with HR and Manufacturing leadership to support personnel development, establish career paths, and maintain a sound performance evaluation process.
* Leads manufacturing-driven projects and cross-functional initiatives based on KPI performance, data review, customer feedback, field quality concerns, or operational needs.

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is on-site 5 days per week.
* Occasional travel may be required for training or meetings.
* Must be able to work flexible hours to accommodate different business needs.

***The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time, based on business needs.***

card.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, General Assembly, Fremont Central Manufacturing Engineering
card.description:
**What to Expect**

The Staff Manufacturing Engineer, GA position, reporting to General Assembly Manufacturing Engineering Manager, is located at our Fremont Factory location. The primary responsibility of this role is to lead, support, and manage introductions of new manufacturing equipment and processes as well as continuous improvement of existing equipment in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This person will drive the implementation of new projects, production lines and product changes. The successful candidate is a self-starter, has strong engineering skills and leadership capabilities, and can manage a small group of engineers to execute multiple projects and priorities at the same time. This role requires working closely with Design Engineering, NPI, Quality, Production, Purchasing, Industrial Engineering, external Line builders, and other departments to take vehicle design changes and new vehicle designs from initial concept through prototype development and into full production, and to transform and adapt existing manufacturing equipment to changing requirements and conditions.

 
**What You'll Do**

* Build and lead a project team of engineers to execute a diverse roadmap of projects including new product introductions and business directives such as capacity increase and cost reduction
* Facilitate performance management, resource allocation, and engineering skill development with manager. Including performance reviews, growth, and development
* Design, procure, and fully commission equipment, specifically: stakeholder buy-in, RFQ, vendor selection, decision analysis, project workflow approvals, installation, and commissioning
* Ensure thorough and proper equipment validation and production startup through FAT, SAT, OEE, availability, complete technical documentation, and transfer of ownership success criteria
* Provide detailed assessments and critical Design For Manufacture (DFM) reviews of Product, Process and Tooling designs
* While executing projects objectively define and achieve OEE, throughput, and cycle time
* Lead all GA engineering groups both internal and external with tooling design and reviews
* Study technologies to expert-level of understanding, utilizing internal & external technical resources to fully understand, teach and lead new / newly implemented technologies
* Develop business cases and ROI studies, and communicate project justification to senior leadership
* Provide technical support, leadership, and training to engineers and cross departmental teams

 
**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or equivalent certification, or proven equivalent experience
* 8+ years of proven experience designing, implementing, and optimizing complex manual and automated manufacturing equipment & processes, preferably in the automotive industry
* Work independently with concepts and documentation from prototype to sustaining activities
* Familiarity with assembly processes, technologies, and platforms, their capabilities, and limitations
* Extensive Proficiency with 3D and 2D CAD platforms
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, and proven interpersonal skills and ability to objectively resolve conflict within a large group
* Able to work flexible hours and schedules as required

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

 

#### **Expected Compensation**

$91,600 - $316,800/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

 
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

card.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
card.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

 

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

 

We are looking for a S **r. Manager, Quality** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to **Director of Quality** and based in **Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week** .

 

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.

* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.

* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.

* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.

* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.

* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.

* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.

* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.

* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.

* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.

* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.

* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.

* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.

* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.

* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)

* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.

* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.

* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.

* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.

* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.

* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.

* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.

* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.

* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.

* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

 

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .

* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.

* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up

* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.

* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)

* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)

* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.

* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.

* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.

* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.

* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.

* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.

* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).

* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.

* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.

* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.

* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.

* Possess a passion for excellence.

* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.

* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.

* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

 

At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title** Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery

**Corporate Title** Director

**Location** Santa Ana, CA

**Overview**

*As a Director within Document Custody Operations, you will lead quality assurance, operations support services, and service delivery to strengthen execution, protect client and organizational interests, and improve service outcomes. You will oversee quality control, training, operational risk and controls, continuous improvement, and sustained regulatory, agency, investor, and audit readiness. As a senior operational representative and Document Custody and agency subject matter expert, you will translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into practical operating standards. You will partner across Operations, Client Services, control functions, Technology, and delivery partners to resolve complex issues and balance client service, efficiency, and custodial obligations.*

**What We Offer You**

* A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
* A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
* Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
* Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs 

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Document Custody quality assurance framework, operating standards, governance, and controls, including maker/checker reviews, segregation of duties, approvals, system validations, and evidence requirements
* Oversee independent, risk-based quality control testing, sampling, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, and remediation validation; report quality performance and emerging risks to senior leadership
* Lead training and knowledge-management governance, including agency and document fundamentals, competency assessments, certification standards, cross-training, and targeted retraining informed by quality findings and audit observations
* Translate Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA), private investor, client, and custodial requirements into procedures and service expectations; guide collateral documentation, certification, endorsements, assignments, allonges, trailing documents, releases, reinstatements, exceptions, and inventory controls
* Lead operational support and client service delivery, including implementations, service levels, capacity planning, complex research, incidents, aging items, and escalations; balance responsiveness with contractual commitments, controls, cost, and risk appetite
Maintain audit and examination readiness, oversee findings and management action plans, and partner with Technology on workflow, automation, data, and reporting enhancements that deliver measurable improvements in quality, capacity, client outcomes, and resilience 

**How You’ll Lead**

* Lead and develop direct reports and matrixed teams across quality assurance, quality control, training, audit support, operational support, service delivery, and process improvement, establishing clear decision rights, accountability, and development objectives
* Partner with Operations, Client Services, and clients as a senior advisor and escalation point, ensuring service commitments are executable, controlled, and aligned with custodial obligations
Influence senior leadership, Audit, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, vendors, and offshore partners to challenge risk decisions constructively, resolve cross-functional issues, and deliver sustainable remediation and transformation 

**Skills You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Operations Management, Mortgage Banking, or a related discipline; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered where permitted by organizational policy
* Extensive experience in document custody, mortgage banking, loan servicing, securities services, collateral management, quality assurance, operational risk, service delivery, or another highly controlled financial-services environment
* Demonstrated experience with Quality Assurance/Quality Control frameworks, control testing, issue management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, training governance, operational reporting, and client escalation management, including support for audits, client examinations, agency reviews, regulatory assessments, or formal control testing
* Knowledge of operational risk, controls, quality management, audit readiness, remediation, and service-delivery governance, with the ability to translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into operational standards
* Working proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using dashboards, workflow tools, quality trackers, case-management systems, or operational reporting platforms
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs 

**Skills That Will Help You Excel**

* Direct working knowledge of Document Custody and FNMA, FHLMC, GNMA, private investor, collateral, certification, release, and exception requirements
* Experience leading managers, professionals, programs, or complex cross-functional operating models, with the ability to influence across functions, locations, vendors, and onshore/offshore teams
* Executive presence and effective written and verbal communication with clients, auditors, senior management, control functions, and technical subject matter experts
* Analytical judgment to identify patterns, quantify operational impacts, challenge assumptions, and make risk-informed decisions
Disciplined prioritization and follow-through when managing multiple critical issues, with timely escalation of material concerns 

**Expectations**

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Santa Ana office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in California is $133,000 to $203,500. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.

At Deutsche Bank, we recognize that our benefit programs have a profound impact on our colleagues. That’s why we are focused on providing benefits and perks that enable our colleagues to live authentically and be their whole selves, at every stage of life. We provide access to physical, emotional, and financial wellness benefits that allow our colleagues to stay financially secure and strike balance between work and home. Click here to learn more!

The California Consumer Privacy Act outlines how companies can use personal information. If you are interested in receiving a copy of Deutsche Bank’s California Privacy Notice please email HR.Direct@DB.com .

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
